title: Stationfall: Integrations
summary: Use maps, scans, power, records, and recovery plans to survive station runs.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Orbital Remnants shares away-route logic, Recovery helps after a failed boarding, Terminal can track station records, and TutorialCore can warn about oxygen mistakes.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Orbital Remnants away-route habits, Recovery fallback plans, Terminal station records, and TutorialCore oxygen or pressure warnings.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If station data is sparse, move one compartment at a time, mark exits, and retreat before cargo weight or system damage traps you.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
